name: Bowers Museum Junior Ambassadors
what_you_do: Work with museum staff to build speaking and leadership skills. You lead visitors on gallery tours. You talk about art and objects from around the world.
who_can_apply: Last time, the program took Orange County high school students entering grades 10 to 12. You need a Bowers Family Membership. Show your interest in art, culture and history.
pay_detail: A Bowers Family Membership is required. The page does not state its price. You can use a membership your family already has.
duration: Summer program. Exact length is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: The last open house was Saturday, May 2, 2026, 10:00 to 11:00 a.m. Dates for the next program year are not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Go to the open house with your family. Then apply. Students are picked based on the application and an interview.
notes: You can earn community service hours. The museum is at 2002 North Main Street, Santa Ana. Call 714-567-3600 for questions.
